name: Pending info – system unavailable
source_text: … failing control with ≤2 retries → finalize_application(PENDING_INFO, SYS_UNAVAILABLE) → reply
expansion: The prefix depends on which control fails (verify_pan in KYC-FLT-022, sanctions_screen in KYC-FLT-026), so only the closing call is fixed; retries are checked by TU-5.
